title: SWARM LENS
description: A field of oriented shards is controlled by persistent draggable lenses. Drag an existing diamond source or press elsewhere to add another, up to six; the sources remain after release and continuously reorganize the swarm. Field strength, orbit/radial balance, reach, coherence, drag and wander create capture, orbit, repulsion and streaming regimes.

visual_finish.composition: one hundred ninety tapered moving shards flow around up to six persistent diamond lenses, creating multiple simultaneous centres of action
visual_finish.material_model: deep blue-black field, cool glassy shards, warm/cyan source polarity diamonds and no transient click circles
detail_scales: individual tapered agents and diamond sources
